_readme: Categories come from the subfolders of REF/ — one folder per style, folder name = style name. This file only adds the prompt text for each folder (matched case-insensitively). If a folder has no entry here, the app still works but the prompt relies on the reference images alone; ask Claude to look at the folder and write its entry.

Bauhaus.tagline: Concentric & parallel linework, muted vintage print colors
Bauhaus.style: Dense families of thin concentric parallel lines forming arcs, racetrack loops and rippling contour waves, sometimes anchored by a bold solid circle; hypnotic repetitive rhythm in the linework; muted vintage palette (deep green, black, warm oranges) on warm cream paper; completely flat inks, crisp edges, subtle 1920s letterpress print feel.

Dream Blob.tagline: Hazy amorphous blobs & auras, rich glowing palette
Dream Blob.style: Soft out-of-focus amorphous blobs and auras: one or a few organic color masses with completely blurred edges that melt into the background; rich saturated cores (electric blue, violet, coral, orange, pink, teal) glowing like an aura; smooth airbrushed gradients with fine film grain; the background is one quiet field — pure white, soft cream, pale grey or deep near-black; no outlines, no hard edges, no geometry anywhere.

Organic Shape.tagline: Bold rounded forms, crisp edges, playful negative space
Organic Shape.style: Bold rounded organic forms with crisp smooth edges — thick ribbons and squiggles, interlocking arcs and chain links, metaball clusters, cutout amoeba silhouettes, stacked rounded blocks or overlapping ovals; each shape in flat saturated color or one simple smooth duotone gradient; playful confident composition with generous negative space against a soft neutral or pastel background; modern art-print energy.
